title: Add server request logging hook
objective: Add dependency-free request logging support to the minimal HTTP server without logging sensitive request data.
scope: Allow the server factory and startup helper to accept an optional logger function
Log completed request method, pathname, status code, and duration
Exclude query strings and request bodies from log entries
Ensure logger failures do not alter response behavior
Add tests, documentation, and handoff evidence

acceptance_criteria.description: The server accepts an optional dependency-free logger function.
Completed requests log method, pathname, status code, and duration in milliseconds.
Log entries exclude query strings and request bodies, and logger failures do not change response behavior.

required_tests: Regression tests for existing health and 404 behavior
Integration test for request logging fields
Privacy test proving query strings and bodies are not logged

reasons: No dependency, persistence, or external API changes
Logger is optional and failures are isolated
